title: Chiplet-Based GPU Architecture with Optical Interconnect
abstract: A GPU with 8 compute chiplets (5nm) connected via silicon photonic interconnect providing 10 Tbps bandwidth, achieving 2 PFLOPS FP16 at 300W.
claims: 8 compute dies connected by silicon photonic interposer with 128 wavelength channels at 80 Gbps.
Micro-ring resonator modulator at 50 Gbps with insertion loss <3 dB.
Chiplet protocol achieving 95% bandwidth utilization, latency <10ns.
problem_statement: Monolithic GPUs reaching reticle limits. Optical interconnects offer 100x bandwidth density.
